day_local: Mgqibelo wenyanga yesithathu elishumi kwixesha eliqhelekileyo
greeting: Egameni likaYise, nelikaNdodana, nelikaMoya oyingcwele. Makube nani, kwaye uThixo woxolo abe nani namhlanje.
penitential:
Nkosi, yiba nenceba nathi.
Kristu, yiba nenceba nathi.
Nkosi, yiba nenceba nathi.
homily:
Kukho izinto ezibonakala zilula kakhulu emhlabeni, kodwa zithwala ubunzima obukhulu xa usima phambi kwazo. Cinga nje ngendawo yokuhlala etafileni, apho umntu ngamnye ekhetha khona isihlalo sakhe, apho umntu azibona ebalulekile khona ngokwasendleleni. Abantu bayajonga, bayabona ukuba ngubani ohlala phi, ngubani ofanele ukuhlonishwa, kwaye ngubani osayinwa njengomkhulu. Kule minyaka yobomi bethu, uBenjamin Vo wayezazi kakuhle ezo ndlela zokuhlala, engumntwana owayenengqondo eqaqambileyo yezibalo nolwazi, kodwa onezandla ezazithobekileyo ezazingafuni ukuziphakamisa phezulu ngaphezu kwabanye. UBen wayengumfana owayenenjongo enkulu, kodwa ekwaziyo ukuhlala phantsi ngokuzola, eyazi ukuba ubungcwele bukukuba ngumntwana phambi koThixo.

KwiVangeli yanamhlanje, uYesu ubona indlela abamenyiweyo abakhetha ngayo izihlalo ezihloniphekileyo kwisidlo somshado. Uyabajonga, aze athethe ngobulumko obujika yonke into: lowo uziphakamisayo uya kuthotshwa, kwayenedelelekayo, kodwa lowo uzithobayo uya kuphakanyiswa. Masiyimele kancinci le mfanekiso… UYesu akathethi nje ngemithetho yetafule okanye indlela yokuziphatha phambi kwabantu abakhulu. Uthetha ngentliziyo eguqukileyo. Uthetha ngendawo yokwenene apho umntu angenela khona ebomini bukaThixo, kungekhona ngamava okuzikhukhumeza, kodwa ngobubele bokuzithoba.

KwiNcwadi kaPawulos kwabaseFilipi namhlanje, uPawulos usixelela amazwi anzima kakhulu, amazwi aphuma entliziyweni ehluphekayo kodwa ethemba ngokuphelele: 'Kuba kum ubomi nguKristu, ukufa kungenzuzo.' Masiyimele le ndinyana… UPawulos ubhalela esentolongweni, eqonda ukuba ubomi bakhe busezandleni zikaThixo. Akoyiki kufa, kuba uyazi ukuba ukuba naye uKristu kuthetha ukuba ukwindawo ekhuselekileyo. UBenjamin Vo wayenezo ndlela zokholo. Kwiminyaka yakhe elishumi elinesihlanu emfushane, uBen wabonisa ukuba ubomi bakhe babungekho ekuzifuneleni yena wedwa, kodwa ekwazeni ukuba ungubani kuThixo. Khumbula indlela awayeyithanda ngayo indalo, indlela awayephila ngayo ngobuhle bokucinga ngezo nqwelo-moya zikhulu zibhabha phezulu, kanye njengaleyo ‘con chim airlines’ awayethanda ukuyihlekisa ngayo nobawo wakhe ngoncumo olumsulwa.

Kodwa ukuthetha ngothando olunjalo kusizisa kwelinye icala lobomi, kwicala eliba nzima ukulithwala ngamanye amaxesha. Alan noThao, nawe Ryan mfowethu omncane, ndiyazi ukuba kule minyane minne idlulileyo ukususela ngowe-13 kuJuni 2026, iintlungu ziza ngamanye amaxesha ngendlela embi kakhulu, zikushiya ungazi nokuba ume ngaphi. Kukho amandla emphefumlo aphelileyo, kukho ubusuku obude lapho ukungabikho kwesitulo sikaBen okanye ukungaphulaphuli kwakhe amabanga ayethethwa nguyise kubangela isikhewu esingazalisekiyo. Kodwa mamela le nyaniso namhlanje: uThixo akamlibalanga uBen, kwaye akakubalelanga nani.

Kwizinto ezenzekayo ebudeni bokugula, abazali abaninzi bazithwala ngokwabo umthwalo wokuzisola: 'Ngaba kukhona endinokukwenza ngcono? Ngaba ndiphosile?' Mamele kakuhle, Alan noThao: uThixo akakubeki icala. UBen akakubeki icala. Ezo zifo aziziswanga zizinto owazenzayo okanye ongazenzanga. Kweli hlabathi, kukho izinto ezenzeka ngaphandle kolawulo lomntu, ngaphandle kwempazamo yomzali. Awuphosanga nto. Uthando lwakho lwalucocekile, lwaluphelele, kwaye uBen wayesazi ukuba unothando olungaka kubazali bakhe nakuRyan. Khipha elo litye lokuzisola ezintliziyweni zenu namhlanje. UBen akajongi iziphoso; ujonge phezulu kuThixo, kwaye uqhubeka esithi kuwe: 'Ba, Mama, musani ukukhala kakhulu, ndikhuselekile.'

Ryan, mfowethu okhoyo apha, ndifuna uthathe oku nawe. UBen akakushiye. Ukhona ecaleni kwakho, eqhubeka ekusebenza njengesikhokelo sothando. UBen wayengumfana owayenenqgondo enkulu yezibalo ne-AI, kodwa ikratshi lakhe elikhulu kwakuwukuba ngumntwana omhle owayehlonipha abazali bakhe. UBen uya kuhlala ekukhuthaza, nangona ungamboni ngamehlo, kodwa uya kumva entliziyweni yakho. Uthando lwenu njengabazalwana luyinto engunaphakade. Xa uziva usodwa, khumbula ukuba uBen ukhona, uyaqhubeka, kwaye uya kuhlala ephila kuthando lukaThixo olungapheliyo.

Masithathe oku namhlanje: uBen wasishiya isipho sothando olungapheliyo. Kwisikhumbuzo salesi sidlo sasezulwini, masime nathi namhlanje siqinisekile ukuba ubomi bukaBen abuphelanga ethuneni. Usemthekweni wasezulwini, apho izinto zonke zintsha khona. Hamba ke namhlanje uphumle, uthembe ukuba uThixo uyakuthanda, kwaye uBen ulinda wena ngoncumo lwakhe oluqhelekileyo. UBen akakho nje kwimbali yenu; ukwikhona apho uThixo enza khona yonke into ibe ntsha. Uthando lwakho, Ben, lusaqhubeka luhamba emhlabeni, lusaqhubeka lukhanya, kwaye lusaqhubeka lukhumbuza wonke umntu okwaziyo ukuba uThixo uyamthanda umntwana wakhe ngaphezu kwayo yonke into. Hlalani neli themba. Hlalani nolu thando. UBen ukhona, uyaqhubeka, kwaye uya kuhlala ephila kuthando lukaThixo olungapheliyo. Amen.
standing_petitions: Sikhulekela uBenjamin nabanye bonke abaswelekileyo, ukuba baphumle ekukhanyeni kukaKristu.
Sikhulekela bonke abasentlungwini nabazilayo, ukuba uThixo abaduduze abanike ithemba.

readings.label: Isifundo sokuqala
readings.text: Bazalwana, naye wonke umzekelo, nokuba kukobuxoki nokuba kukonyaniso, uKristu uyashunyayelwa; kwaye kuloo nto ndiyavuya. Eneneni ndiya kuqhubeka ndisivuya; kuba ndiyazi ukuba le nto iya kuba yintsindiso kum ngemithandazo yenu nangoxhaso lomoya kaYesu Kristu. Ngokulindela kwam kwamkhulu nethemba lam, ukuba angekhe ndidanise ngantoni na, kodwa ngesibindi esiphelele, ngoku njengaminyonke, uKristu uya kukhuliswa emzimbeni wam, nokuba kungobomi nokuba kungokufa. Kuba kum ubomi nguKristu, kwaye ukufa kungenzuzo. Ukuba ndiyaqhubeka ndiphila enyameni, oko kuthetha umsebenzi ovelisayo kum. Kwaye andazi ukuba ndiya kukhetha ntoni na. Ndibanjwe phakathi kwezi zimbini. Ndinqwenela ukumka ndiye kuba noKristu, kuba oko kulungile kakhulu; kodwa ukuhlala kwam enyameni kuyimfuneko ngakumbi ngenxa yenu. Kwaye ndiyazi ngokuqinisekileyo oku, ukuba ndiya kuhlala ndize ndiqhubeke kwinkonzo yenu nonke, ukuze nikhule nibe nemivuyo elukholweni, ukuze ukugwagwisa kwenu kuKristu Yesu kuphuphume ngam xa ndibuyela kuni kwakhona.

readings.label: INdumiso yokuphendula
readings.text:
R. Umphefumlo wam unxanelwe uThixo ophilileyo.
Njengexhala elilangazelela imisinga yamanzi,
unjalo umphefumlo wam othi ukulangazelela wena, Thixo.
R. Umphefumlo wam unxanelwe uThixo ophilileyo.
Unxanelwe uThixo umphefumlo wam, uThixo ophilileyo;
Ndiya kuza nini na ndize ndibonakale ebusweni bukaThixo?
R. Umphefumlo wam unxanelwe uThixo ophilileyo.
Ndaya nesihlwele,
ndazikhokelela ngomkhosi endlwini kaThixo,
Ngezwi luvuyo olukhulu nokubulela,
nesiwele esigcina umthendeleko.
R. Umphefumlo wam unxanelwe uThixo ophilileyo.

readings.label: IVangeli
readings.text: Kwaba ngomhla wesabatha uYesu waya kudla isidlo endlwini yomnye wabaphathi bafarisi, kwaye abantu babemjonga ngqo. Wathetha umzekelo kwabo babemenyiwe, ebonile indlela abakhetha ngayo izihlalo ezihloniphekileyo etafuleni, wathi: 'Xa umenywe ngumntu emshadweni, ungahlali esihlalweni esihloniphekileyo; hleze umntu ohlonipheke ngakumbi kunawe amenywe nguye, afike lowo ukumenyileyo wena naye, athi kuwe, "Nikela indawo yakhe lo mntu;" uze ke ngoku uqale ngeentloni ukuya kuthatha indawo ephantsi. Hayi ke, xa umenywe, yiya uthathe indawo ephantsi, ukuze xa afikayo lowo ukumenyileyo athi kuwe, "Mhlobo wam, nyukela phezulu." Uze ke ube nembeko phambi kwabo bonke abahleli nawe etafuleni. Kuba wonke oziphakamisayo uya kuthotshwa, kwaye ozithobayo uya kuphakanyiswa.'

spiritual_communion: Nkosi yam Yesuye Kristu, ndiyakholwa ukuba ukho kwiSakramente Eyingcwele yeAltare. Ndikuthanda ngaphezu kwento zonke, kwaye ndinqwenela ukuba nawe emphefumlweni wam. Njengoko ndingenako ngoku ukwamkela kwiSakramente, nceda uze emphefumlweni wam ngendlela yomoya. Ndiyamkela njengokuba sele ukhona, kwaye ndiyazibophelela kuwe ngokuphelele; musa ukundivumela ukuba ndahlukaniswe nawe naphakade. Amen.
closing: Ngamana uxolo lukaThixo olunqanda konke ukuqonda lungagcina iintliziyo zenu nengqondo zenu kuKristu Yesu. Makube njalo.
day: Saturday of the Thirtieth Week in Ordinary Time

pet_prayers.text: Thinking of you buddy! Stop by to say hello whenever you can okay? Love you Ben

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Hey Ben - Been dreaming about you a lot. Hope you're having fun up in heaven. Please look after our family. Remember to come say hi daily. We miss you so much!

Ben ơi, trong giấc ngủ anh Huy đã thấy Ben về thăm anh, trao cho anh lời cầu nguyện để hai anh em mình lại được tìm thấy nhau. Xin Chúa thương nhậm lời Ben, cho Ben được hưởng ngàn thu bình an bên Chúa. Nếu có thể, xin Ben lại ghé thăm anh trong những giấc mơ tiếp theo nhé, dù chỉ là một lời chào hay một nụ cười thân thương như ngày nào.

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Ben, my sweet boy, I miss you so much. Thank you for visiting me and Chú Chris last night. He told me he saw you flying a helicopter—so free, joyful, and strong up there. Down here, Mom and I are crying more and more each day. A piece of my heart feels completely dead without you, Ben. Please watch over us, pray for your mom, your brother Ryan, and me, and give us the strength to keep going. We love you forever

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Today marks 100 days without you. Miss you a whole a lot Ben. Feel free to visit any time! See you around buddy! Love you!

Ben ơi, nay anh M đi xử lý hồ sơ ở Cam Ranh, đi ngang qua Cam Ranh Airport. Rồi cuộc nói chuyện về máy bay của Ben lại ùa về, nhớ nhiều kỷ niệm về Ben lắm ( anh M sẽ giữ kín kakaka). Quỷ nhỏ, tự nhiên nghĩ về mày buồn dễ sợ. Hãy đi đến những nơi mà Ben muốn nha và đừng quên là luôn nhớ về gia đình mình nhé, thương em trai nhiều. Giá như !!!!!!!!!

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: What happened my son? It's been 3 months since you left us. Missing you so much my whole body aches. Mom cries every day now... What are we going to do now Ben?  Please pray for us.
